CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 24, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – June 24, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – June 10, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the June 10, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the June 10, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Vice Chair Udani, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  RE-ORDERING OF THE AGENDA:

  •  This is a request from the City Architect to add Discussion Item #7 to
  the agenda. This item is an informational presentation to the Design
  Review Board on the design review process and supplemental
  materials that are intended to help facilitate design review. The
  Design Review Board voted to include Discussion Item #7 to today’s
  agenda, which was followed by a roll call vote:

   Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-060
  • 160 East Main Street
  • Applicant: Judy Yam
  • Request: This is an application for new exterior color change of an
  existing 1-story commercial building for the Bank of America,
  including painting of exterior walls and a canopy.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-043
  • 711 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Kasey Clark
  • Request: This is an application for new signage on an existing 1-
  story commercial building, and refacing of an existing freestanding
  pylon sign, for Everbank.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chair Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-077
  • 1525 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Joseph Westbrook & Shyla Olafsson
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign on an existing 1-
  story commercial building for Alhambra Orthodontics.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide appropriate dimensions to the logo sign in elevation that
  captures the entire logo parameters.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-031
  • 1318 West Alhambra Road
  • Applicant: Miaoyan Shih
  • Request: This is an application for two (2) new wall signs on an
  existing 1-story commercial building for the “Tong Jue Si” Meditation
  Center.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Update the elevations to show proposed height and placement of
  the sign with respect to finish grade and centered vertically with
  building storefront entry.

PUBLIC COMMENTS:

  1) Lola Armendariz

MOTION:

  3
  06/24/2025
   •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Update the elevations to show proposed height and placement of
  the sign with respect to finish grade and centered vertically with
  building storefront entry.
  2) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chair Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-1-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  Ng
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-144
  • 2926 Pyrenees Drive
  • Applicant: Philip Chan & Tsung Po Tsai
  • Request: This is an application for new construction of a 2,900 SF 2-
  story single-family dwelling with an attached 2-car garage, and front
  yard design work.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant shall either provide a minimum of one roof line
  offset at least five feet in length along the east façade to comply
  with the roof line offset requirement of AMC Section 23.13.020
  [Building Design Requirements] and work with the City Architect
  on the roof redesign and placement, or shall reduce the east
  façade length to 50 feet or less so that the roof line offset
  requirement standard shall not apply.
  2) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant shall either provide a minimum of one roof line
  vertical offset at least five feet in length along the east façade to
  comply with the roof line offset requirement of AMC Section
  23.13.020 [Building Design Requirements] and work with the City
  Architect on the roof redesign and placement, or shall reduce the
  east façade length to 50 feet or less so that the roof line offset
  requirement standard shall not apply.

  4
  06/24/2025
   2) Update the pedestrian gate next to the garage to be consistent in
  design and style to the other railings on the project.
  3) Update the plans to further define the top rail design on the
  proposed 2nd floor glass railing, and to match material and color
  as other railings on the project.
  4) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  AGENDA

F.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

G.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:45 P.M. to
